name: Haptics
description: Build hardware systems that bring touch, force, scent, and movement into XR experiences. We bridge the gap between the physical and the real world.

name: BCI
description: Explore interacting with virtual worlds via the power of the mind. We train and use machine learning to use brainwaves as alternative inputs.

name: Software
description: Develop software that brings virtual experiences into the physical world. We build applications that improve the daily lives of our users.

name: Game Dev
description: Create VR games in Unity, unleashing creativity in a life-like medium. We build fun and immersive experiences.

name: Business
description: Coordinate CUXR's logistics and business operations. We handle outreach, recruitment, and industry collaborations.
